title: RL Post-Training Builds Compositional Reasoning Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2607.07646v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Does RL post-training merely amplify primitive skills already latent in a base model, or can it compose primitive skills into new higher-level strategies? We study this question in a fully observable rewrite-grammar environment where the pretraining distribution is known and every generated rewrite can be audited. A Transformer is pretrained on primitive symbol-rewrite chains and post-trained on a Trace-based reasoning task with only a binary final-answer reward. RL solves held-out problems that remain rarely solved by the pretrained model even under much larger sampling budgets, while rejection fine-tuning improves early but plateaus. Trace analysis shows that RL reorganizes primitive competence through a phased compositional mechanism: it first strengthens primitive reductions, then discovers valid composed procedures. translated_title: 强化学习后训练构建组合推理策略
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）后训练仅仅是放大基础模型中已经潜在存在的基础技能，还是能够将基础技能组合成新的更高层级策略？我们在一个完全可观测的重写语法环境中研究这个问题，在该环境中预训练分布是已知的，且每一个生成的重写都可以被审计。Transformer模型首先在基础符号重写链上进行预训练，然后在一个基于Trace的推理任务上进行后训练，仅使用二元的最终答案奖励。强化学习能够解决那些预训练模型即使在更大的采样预算下也极少能解决的保留测试问题，而拒绝采样微调虽然早期有所提升但随后趋于停滞。Trace分析显示，强化学习通过一种分阶段的组合机制重新组织基础能力：它首先强化基础规约，然后发现有效的组合程序，包括将有序的基础收缩链折叠起来的顺序组合，以及并行组合……
tldr: 强化学习后训练并非只是放大预训练模型已有的基础技能，而是通过“先强化基础规约、再发现顺序与并行组合程序”的分阶段组合机制，将基础技能重组为新的更高层级推理策略，从而解决预训练模型几乎无法解决的问题。
en_tdlr: RL post-training does not merely amplify latent primitive skills, but reorganizes them into new higher-level compositional reasoning strategies through a phased mechanism—first strengthening primitive reductions, then discovering sequential and parallel compositions—enabling it to solve problems that the pretrained model rarely solves even with much larger sampling budgets.
